blind.description: A small round woven wicker basket with an arched handle across the top. Inside is a yellow cloth or straw lining packed with smooth eggs—white eggs on one side and brown eggs on the other. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without broken polygons, floating elements, or melted geometry.
blind.from_above: A circular brown woven basket with a central arched handle dividing the interior, showing white eggs arranged on one side and reddish-brown eggs on the opposite side over a yellow interior base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1 foot tall including the handle) and slightly wider than the figure's diameter (about 1 to 1.2 feet wide).
